subject: reasoning
question: D is married to F. B is the wife of Q. G is the daughter of A. F is the mother of Q. A is the sister of D. How is D related to B?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) D is married to F.

2) F is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7043835d424f2f6abc85ad9b8f03194bc31c7d473c579ca08394caf8cef759ea.png] 

3) A is the sister of D.

4) G is the daughter of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/293add3bb2f14203d4e05bf79212457ac23b050513fce8386b543e62da41c73e.png] 

5) B is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e7c3f1a5735a99719c67e153e2575d6ddd14ca1113a10f46392d86d14c67f6b.png] 

Thus, D is B's father-in-law or husband's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
